reply_text:
I posted a reply in #central-team, addressed to you. It says I can't confirm the 8 April date, and that it should be treated as unverified.

One thing I got wrong: the reply names Marcus Lindqvist and the North team as Brackenwater's owners. That came from a knowledge note, and it is about an account you may not be able to see. I should have left it out. I can't delete the post from here, so if you want it corrected, tell me and I'll post a short follow-up.

To check the renewal date, ask Marcus or whoever owns the Brackenwater contract record. Finance terms, including contract dates tied to money, go through June Osei-Lark or Anselm Grieve.
